goal: Nan waves at the classroom window next to a small green plant in a pot.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 1 shows the girl Nan (the approved 3D character; ignore the dog next to her, it must not appear). Picture 2 is a close-up of Nan's face with the correct, clean eyes: copy her face and eyes from picture 2 exactly. Each eye ends in a smooth, rounded outer corner with one short, thick, curved eyelash flick; there is no pale skin flap, no torn edge, and no separate small tick mark at any eye corner. Picture 1 (the full-body view) has tiny eye-corner rendering errors: do not copy them. Keep Nan exactly as in picture 1, with the face of picture 2: black-brown hair in two buns with red hair ties, large dark-brown eyes, an orange T-shirt with a white star, red shorts, white sneakers. Picture 3 shows a fern; use it as the small green plant in a small clay pot, to the right of Nan. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. Nan keeps her chibi proportions: a big head and a small body. Her hands are small, chubby child hands with five clear short fingers and a thumb, never fists unless stated. A hand that reaches toward the camera looks larger because of perspective; that is correct. The picture: a full-body shot from the front at a low camera height. Nan stands slightly left of the middle, faces the camera, and fills about two thirds of the frame height; her feet are on a light wooden floor with a soft shadow. She waves hello with her raised right hand (on the left side of the picture), open, palm toward the viewer, with a small happy open-mouth smile. Her other arm hangs relaxed with a natural small hand. Behind her is a simple bright classroom wall with one large window with a white frame and a soft blue sky, and a cream wall. The green plant in its pot stands on the floor at the lower right, next to her, as tall as her knee. The page text is "Hello, I am Nan." and is context only: do not draw any text. Clean eye corners with no skin flaps, and no streaks or marks on the face. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no eyelash ticks, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. Keep the window frame, the plant, the pot, and the floor boards as thick, closed outlines.
